_about: KS4 root controls that were READ in their lesson and are not answers: nothing asks for a value, so there is nothing to save. Each entry names the reason. Read by tools/activity_save_coverage.py; a control named neither here nor in ROOT_FORMS (shared/mrbadmus.v2.js) counts as NOT saved. Sliders (type=range) are counted as explorations without being listed.
